module.name: Media
module.changelog: *2.2.0* Split into a list page and an editor, the shape the rest of FreePBX uses. ?display=oryk_media is now only the list, with an Add button; ?display=oryk_media&edit= opens that recording for re-recording or regeneration, and &edit= with nothing after it is a new one. Saving returns to the list. *2.1.0* Second way to create media: local Piper text to speech, alongside the microphone recorder. Runs entirely on this server -- no API, no network. Optional: without the bundled runtime or sox the tab says so and recording is unaffected. The runtime and the default voice are fetched once by fwconsole ma install; a failed download never fails the install, and ORYK_MEDIA_SKIP_TTS_FETCH opts out. Voices are an explicit server-side registry, never a directory scan. *2.0.0* Rewritten as a browser audio recorder: record from a mic in the admin UI and save straight into the custom sounds directory for use in System Recordings. Removes the dark mode / touch scroll / CSS override layer inherited from oryk_gui. *1.1.2* Settings save on change, no Submit button; cache-busted assets *1.1.1* Touch Scroll now honors its setting; fixed jQuery/body load-order bugs that kept it from ever running *1.1.0* Dark Mode setting; per-user settings persistence (kvstore) with ajax save *1.0.1* New
module.description: Record audio in the browser or generate it with local text to speech, and save it for System Recordings.
